title: Distinguished triangles in a triangulated localization come from the source
statement: Let $\mathcal D$ be a triangulated category and $S$ a multiplicative system compatible with the triangulated structure, with localization $Q:\mathcal D\to S^{-1}\mathcal D$ [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]. Then $S^{-1}\mathcal D$ carries a unique structure of triangulated category such that $[1]\circ Q=Q\circ[1]$ and $Q$ is exact; for it, a triangle of $S^{-1}\mathcal D$ is distinguished if and only if it is isomorphic to the image under $Q$ of a distinguished triangle of $\mathcal D$.
